description: He wears a knee-length dark forest-green textured tunic with gold knotwork borders along the front, cuffs and lower hem, over a cream linen underlayer visible at wrists and below the tunic. A large dark green woven cloak with gold knotwork borders and fringe drapes over his shoulders and down one side, held by a round knotwork brooch. A broad brown leather belt with round metal discs and a circular buckle has a long ornamented hanging strap. Taupe trousers gather into brown leather boots with crossed wrapping straps. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
